vulnerability_analysis: The contract owner can abuse their privileges by setting txFee to a high value (e.g., 99) and changing FeeAddress to their own address. When any user (except FeeAddress) transfers tokens, 99% of the transfer amount goes to the FeeAddress as fee. This allows the owner to steal funds from users through excessive fees.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, set txFee to 99 and FeeAddress to attacker address, then have a victim transfer tokens to trigger the fee collection.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the contract. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank(). 3. Call updateFee(99, 0, attacker) to set high fee and redirect fees to attacker. 4. Create a victim address and give it tokens using deal(). 5. Make the victim transfer tokens to another address, triggering the 99% fee. 6. Verify attacker's balance increased significantly.
